title: MiawDoku
description: MiawDoku! – the purrfect Sudoku-inspired puzzle game for cat lovers! Swap out numbers for adorable cat characters and challenge your mind by solving each grid with a unique twist. This game combines classic logic puzzles with a playful, feline theme, offering hours of fun for both cat enthusiasts and puzzle fans. Dive into MiawDoku! and let the puzzle-solving begin with a touch of whiskers and paws!
instructions: Fill each 3x3 subgrid row and column with each unique cat only once Every row column and subgrid should contain all nine different cats with no repeats
